title: Israeli Strikes, Detonations Hit Kfartebnit, Deir Seryan, Baraashit, Ali al-Taher
detail: Overnight into Monday, the Israeli military struck Kfartebnit, Deir Seryan, Baraashit, Ali al-Taher and Wadi Zebqine, while artillery shelled al-Mansouri, Nabatieh al-Fawqa, Zawtar al-Sharqiyeh, Beit Leef, Wadi Slouqi, Touline, Hadatha, Baraashit, Majdalzoun, Kounine and Mayfadoun. Israeli forces also carried out massive controlled detonations in Baraashit and Ainata, dropped flare bombs over Zawtar al-Sharqiyeh, Markaba, Houla and Hadatha, and opened heavy machine-gun fire toward Sarbine, Haddatha and the outskirts of Mays al-Jabal, Wadi Slouqi and Wadi Zebqine. No casualties were reported.

media.caption: Israeli strikes and detonations hit Kfartebnit, Deir Seryan, Baraashit and Ali al-Taher overnight, Sep 21, 2026

title: Hezbollah MP Fadlallah Attacks Aoun, Says Group 'Regaining Strength'
detail: Hezbollah MP Hassan Fadlallah accused President Joseph Aoun of creating a 'deep rift' with the Lebanese public and of breaking commitments made to the party before his election. Fadlallah said the 'Resistance today is firm, it is regaining its strength, and actively preparing to confront the enemy,' while insisting Hezbollah does not oppose diplomacy provided it is grounded in 'rights, national consensus, and strength.'

media.caption: Hezbollah MP Hassan Fadlallah criticizes President Aoun and asserts the party's readiness, Sep 21, 2026
